Floyd: slow + fast; they meet iff cycle exists. O(n).

For linked list cycle detect I will use two pointers advancing at 1x and 2x.

```python
def has_cycle(head):
    slow = fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
        if slow is fast: return True
    return False
```
